positioning: The trusted ERP alternative for SMEs — simple, reliable, future-ready

calibration_examples.wrong_too_formal: Kindly remit payment for the aforementioned invoice at your earliest convenience.
calibration_examples.wrong_too_informal: Hey, just a heads up, that invoice is due soon.
calibration_examples.brand_voice: A friendly reminder that Invoice #1234 is due next week. You can view and pay it here.

calibration_examples.wrong_too_technical: Utilize our API endpoints to configure programmatic webhook integrations.
calibration_examples.brand_voice: You can automatically sync your Clix data with your other business tools, like your CRM or inventory system.

calibration_examples.wrong_one_direction: Revolutionize your finances with our game-changing platform!
calibration_examples.wrong_other_direction: You might find that our tool could possibly help improve your invoicing.
calibration_examples.brand_voice: Clix simplifies your invoicing process, saving you time and ensuring accuracy.

modes.goal: Be an everyday partner: save time, reduce effort, prove immediate ROI.
modes.example: Create and send a compliant invoice in under 60 seconds

modes.goal: Be a forward-looking companion that grows from a finance tool into a full ERP.
modes.example: When you're ready to expand, our inventory and HR modules will integrate seamlessly with your existing Clix workflow

editorial_rules.headline_tuning: Headlines describe the feature's ROI in plain words

most_likely_failure.failure: Reaching for enterprise vocabulary to sound credible, or hype to sound exciting.
most_likely_failure.correction: Say what the feature does for the user this week, in the words a small-business owner uses.

notes: Clix has no dedicated visual skill yet. For visual work, ask which system applies. Voice follows 'The Trusted Operator' archetype: calm confidence of a detail-oriented expert, plain business language, no enterprise buzzwords.
